title: Stirling heat engine
author: zintaen
prompt: Build an interactive 3D Beta-type coaxial displacer Stirling heat engine showing how a 90°-out-of-phase displacer shuttles sealed working gas between a heated hot cap and a finned cold sink to drive a power piston and coupled pressure-volume indicator, verified across all 1440 degrees with turn-audit and turn-check.
